# GitPulse

GitPulse is an open-source, local-first Git repository automation CLI for developers.

## Primary site

https://start-gitpulse.vercel.app/

## Explore

- Playground: https://start-gitpulse.vercel.app/playground
- Documentation: https://start-gitpulse.vercel.app/docs
- GitHub: https://github.com/dinalegw/GitPulse

## Core capabilities

- Repository validation before automated changes
- Dry-run execution
- Scheduled Git workflows
- Controlled commit and push workflows
- Cross-platform CLI for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- Local configuration and diagnostics
- `doctor`, `validate`, `status`, and `logs` commands

## Responsible use

GitPulse automates user-configured Git operations. It is not intended to fabricate development activity or deceive GitHub. Users are responsible for ensuring automated changes represent legitimate repository activity.
